purpose: Test three fixed queue-density low/middle thresholds for a warm-gated ordinal / exact LoadLeast / idle-warm-gated ordinal router on fresh E66-E70; all 60 runs remain blinded until QC and pairing complete.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E66-E70 were declared in the V30 full source manifest but were never captured, referenced, executed, or inspected; E21-E65 are closed and E11-E20 remain sealed.

source.high_profile_note: Frozen high remains 7k; V31 is low only.

diagnostic_basis.v30a: Warm-gated singleton profile retained more throughput but ranked fourth in QPR.
diagnostic_basis.v30b: Idle-warm-gated singleton profile ranked first in QPR but sixth in throughput.
diagnostic_basis.closed_cohort_observation: Their assignment disagreement occurred at much higher current pending-plus-runnable queue density in the hard seeds than the easy seeds.
diagnostic_basis.fixed_router: Below the low/middle threshold use V30b; from that threshold to below 32 tasks/node use exact LoadLeast current-demand; at or above 32 use V30a.
diagnostic_basis.threshold_basis: 8 is the previously preregistered V21 low-density boundary, 12 is the legacy paper-implementation queue normalizer, and 16 is the adjacent power-of-two sensitivity point; the 32 high boundary is the already registered adaptive-proxy boundary.

router_inputs: current feasible warm and idle-warm container membership

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit before capture; build and run serially; reveal after all QC and pairing.

eligibility_per_candidate: mean fixed-window throughput strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
mean QPR strictly exceeds all nine baseline means
frozen V8 middle/high retain first place in both metrics
selection_rule: Freeze the first passing candidate in fixed v31a, v31b, v31c priority; ties fail; otherwise select none and close E66-E70.

confirmation.closure_requirement: First in mean throughput and QPR for every load against frozen E11-E20 baselines.
